text_block_list.text:
After overcoming three years together with 
Symboli Kris S, just as my mind had 
finally settled down—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I'm about to snap.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—The hot spring voucher... I won before. 
It's... about to expire.

"Come to think of it, Symboli Kris S 
entrusted this to me to give to you once 
you fulfilled your mission."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—My mission... continues... without end. 
However... I have safely reached... this 
milestone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
There is no better time than now to make 
use of it.

And so. To get some rest, I came to a hot 
spring inn with Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Are you... feeling motion 
sick... from the travel?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I see. Then—at reception—let us leave—our 
luggage.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Also—I'm not terribly familiar with 
it, but— I looked into—some nearby 
sightseeing spots."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
If there's a place... you want to go... 
Please tell me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Travel—it is crucial—to plan carefully.

—Even at a vacation destination, Symboli 
Kris S's strict and solemn demeanor 
remained unchanged.

And so, touring nearby sightseeing spots 
together with her—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. You're back―

Returning to the room from the grand 
bathâ Symboli Kris S was deep in 
thought, spreadsheets and documents laid 
out across the tatami.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I was thinking... about my future goals.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Trainer— I was able to 
fulfill—my purpose for coming to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yet—as long as I can run— the 
mission—remains. New talents—are also 
sprouting—one after another.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"What I must fulfill—in the future of the 
Japanese racing world—I was thinking about 
it once more."

Even though we came to the hot springs as 
a reward for running this far and 
delivering results, her thoroughness 
hasn't changed a bit.
choice_data_list:
Before that, would you keep me company for 
a bit?

Before that, could you keep me company for 
a bit?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Is this... a massage chair? A 
coin-operated one—"
choice_data_list: Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...If you're recommending it... I 
suppose—I'll try it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...It's a strange—sensation—though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Not bad, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Table tennis—can be played too, I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............ I understand――the bare 
minimum.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I accept your challenge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Smash！

"Ever since we met, Symboli Kris S has 
never stopped running, so I decided to let 
her spend some quiet, relaxing time."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I really... let loose and went too far.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Yaaawn——

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: Looks like you managed to unwind nicely.
Looks like you were able to relax nicely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――No. This――is――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—Damn it... I need to think... about the 
future... even though... I have to...”
choice_data_list:
Surely it's okay to take it easy just for 
today.

At least for today, you deserve to take it 
easy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Just for... today...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...*snooze*... *snooze*...

Symboli Kris S sleeps with a contented 
look on her face. I gently pull the 
blanket over her.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Symboli Kris S...
